publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.15 adds deliberate hosted installs without outbound email on the exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.119 pin. Select MAIL_PROVIDER=none explicitly and omit sender and sending credentials; missing or deferred mail selection does not mean off. First-run and sign-in pages explain mail-off operation. Sign in with guarded rer signin from the deploying checkout, retaining its deployment receipt and the deploying account's credentials. Email links, invitations and email alerts are unavailable while mail is off; refused invitations explain that email is needed and create no invitation or account, and email alerts are never recorded as sent. Local development and demo mail behavior is unchanged; simulated notification outcomes, including restored history, say that no email was sent. Public /health includes buildVersion from the running package. Operations diagnostics use the default SendGrid provider when MAIL_PROVIDER is unset and validate saved local settings when present. Imported expected-period heartbeat jobs can be edited in the monitor editor without losing their job settings; cron and short-period jobs use Job schedule and runs. Dependencies include re2js 2.8.7. Switching email back on through rer deploy is not established by this release. No database migration or new required setting is added; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup; local CLI export requires the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide. Keep that cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then deploy as usual. Earlier known issues and upgrade cautions remain, including old heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, erased-people restore, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body bound and unestablished large-scale archive operation. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.13; it is not a new 0.5.15 capture.
